findings.claim: Two UI modules each fit a track outline into an SVG box and build the closed path with the same code: the bounding box, a uniform scale, centring offsets and an `M…L…Z` string rounded by `r1`. The private `r1` helper is also declared twice.
findings.evidence:
src/ui/track-card.ts:22 `const r1 = (n: number): number => Math.round(n * 10) / 10;` and :25-34 `outlinePath`: `const xs = outline.map((p) => p[0]); const zs = outline.map((p) => p[1]); … const scale = Math.min((THUMB_W - THUMB_PAD * 2) / (maxX - minX || 1), (THUMB_H - THUMB_PAD * 2) / (maxZ - minZ || 1)); const ox = (THUMB_W - (maxX - minX) * scale) / 2 - minX * scale; … return `M${outline.map(([x, z]) => `${r1(x * scale + ox)} ${r1(z * scale + oz)}`).join('L')}Z`;`
src/ui/hud.ts:40 `const r1 = (v: number): number => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;` and :135-146 in rebuild(): `const xs = outline.map((p) => p[0]); const zs = outline.map((p) => p[1]); … scale = Math.min((MAP_W - 2 * MAP_PAD) / w, (MAP_H - 2 * MAP_PAD) / d); ox = (MAP_W - w * scale) / 2 - minX * scale; oz = …; const pts = outline.map(([x, z]) => `${r1(x * scale + ox)} ${r1(z * scale + oz)}`); const path = pts.length ? `M${pts.join('L')}Z` : '';`
The only difference is the guard for a zero extent (`|| 1` against `Math.max(…, 1e-6)`). That guard matters only when every point shares an x or a z. No registered track or stage fixture does that.
findings.suggestedFix: Export one `fitOutline(outline, w, h, pad): { scale, ox, oz, d }` and the `r1` helper from track-card.ts, using the same `||1` guard and arithmetic as outlinePath. Make `outlinePath` return `fitOutline(...).d`, and have hud.ts rebuild() take scale/ox/oz/d from it. Then delete hud.ts's copy and its `r1`. For non-degenerate outlines the arithmetic is the same operations in the same order, so the paths and dot positions keep the same values. The screens gate confirms the HUD minimap and track cards are unchanged.

findings.claim: The start-screen stage rebuilds the game's track-card list with a copy of the game's mapping, and writes the minimap stride as a bare 8. B08 added this copy after C025 was filed, so C025 now misses two of the four stride sites (game.ts:151 and start.stage.ts:12).
findings.evidence:
src/game.ts:151 `tracks: TRACKS.map((t) => ({ id: t.id, name: t.name, outline: trackLayout(t).centre.filter((_, i) => i % MINIMAP_STRIDE === 0) })),`
src/ui/stages/start.stage.ts:12 `return TRACKS.map((t) => ({ id: t.id, name: t.name, outline: trackLayout(t).centre.filter((_, i) => i % 8 === 0) }));`
The other stride copies are src/game.ts:293 `world.track.layout.centre.filter((_, i) => i % MINIMAP_STRIDE === 0)` and src/ui/stages/stage.ts:72 `centre.filter((_, i) => i % 8 === 0)`. The constant is src/game.ts:33 `const MINIMAP_STRIDE = 8;`.
findings.suggestedFix: Combine this with C025. Export `minimapOutline(centre)` (stride 8) from a UI module that game.ts and the stages already import, for example src/ui/track-card.ts. Add `trackCardViews(tracks)` next to it, returning `{ id, name, outline: minimapOutline(trackLayout(t).centre) }`. Call it from game.ts:151 and start.stage.ts:12, and use minimapOutline at game.ts:293 and stage.ts:72. Then delete MINIMAP_STRIDE. The values are the same, so the DOM is the same.

confirmations.note: The literals are still there; only the scene.ts line numbers moved. scene.ts:156-157 `let viewW = 844; let viewH = 390;`, :235-236 `new Vector2(844, 390)` / `initial.x || 844, initial.y || 390`; camera.ts:85 `createCameraRig(width = 844, height = 390)`; materials/index.ts:147 `new Vector2(844, 390)` and :173 `/ 844`. It is still a duplicate of C031.
